title: Kenyan Biryani Keto Dinner
description: A keto version of the traditional Kenyan biryani dish, made with flavorful meat and spices.

ingredients.name: Beef (sirloin or ribeye)
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-fat cut of meat, suitable for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Rice (cauliflower-based or coconut-based)
ingredients.notes: Use a low-carb alternative to traditional rice.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: Chopped, to add flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated, to add flavor and aroma.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: To season and bring out flavors.

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they're lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the spices, salt, and rice to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for another 5-7 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through and the rice is tender.
